description: Upagraha (sub-planet) definitions, calculation methods, and interpretations for Vedic astrology

gulika.name: Gulika
gulika.description: Most important upagraha. Calculated from Saturn's portion of the day. Rising sign at start of Saturn's portion.

house_effects.1: Health problems, thin body, fearful nature, obstacles in early life
house_effects.2: Financial difficulties, harsh speech, family disputes, poor eyesight
house_effects.3: Brave but quarrelsome siblings, good for courage, short travels troublesome
house_effects.4: Unhappy domestic life, mother's health issues, problems with property and vehicles
house_effects.5: Difficulty with children, poor investments, disturbed education, mental anxiety
house_effects.6: Can be good - destroys enemies, but health issues persist, debts manageable
house_effects.7: Marriage troubles, spouse health issues, partnership problems
house_effects.8: Chronic health issues, accidents, inheritance disputes, interest in occult
house_effects.9: Trouble with father/guru, obstacles in higher education, pilgrimage delays
house_effects.10: Career setbacks, loss of reputation, government problems
house_effects.11: Reduced gains, elder sibling troubles, unfulfilled desires
house_effects.12: Expenses, hospitalization, foreign travel with difficulties, spiritual inclination

mandi.name: Mandi
mandi.description: End point of Saturn's portion. Similar to Gulika but uses end of Saturn's portion instead of start.

house_effects.1: Weak constitution, fear of poison, obstacles in life path
house_effects.2: Speech defects, family problems, poor food habits
house_effects.3: Courage issues, sibling problems, communication difficulties
house_effects.4: Property disputes, vehicle accidents, mother's troubles
house_effects.5: Children's problems, poor judgment, stomach issues
house_effects.6: Victory over enemies with effort, service-related problems
house_effects.7: Marital disharmony, business losses with partners
house_effects.8: Longevity concerns, hidden diseases, unexpected events
house_effects.9: Luck blocked, father's problems, religious conflicts
house_effects.10: Professional setbacks, authority issues, karmic debts in career

yamaghanda.name: Yamaghanda
yamaghanda.description: Jupiter's portion of the day. Associated with Yama (death). Less malefic than Gulika.

house_effects.1: Obstacles but eventual recovery, interest in law/justice
house_effects.2: Family disputes about inheritance, speech issues
house_effects.6: Helps defeat enemies, legal matters favorable
house_effects.9: Spiritual tests, father's health, pilgrimage obstacles
house_effects.10: Career challenges leading to growth, government issues

kala.name: Kala
kala.description: Sun's portion of the day. Related to time and death.

mrityu.name: Mrityu
mrityu.description: Mars-based death point. Associated with accidents and sudden events.

dhooma.name: Dhooma
dhooma.description: Mathematical upagraha derived from Sun. Represents smoke/obscurity.
dhooma.effects: Creates confusion, lack of clarity, deception in the house it occupies

vyatipata.name: Vyatipata
vyatipata.description: Derived from Dhooma. Represents calamities and obstacles.
vyatipata.effects: Sudden reversals, accidents, unexpected problems in its house

parivesha.name: Parivesha
parivesha.description: Derived from Vyatipata. Represents a protective halo.
parivesha.effects: Protection, divine grace, spiritual advancement in its house

indrachapa.name: Indrachapa
indrachapa.description: Derived from Parivesha. Represents Indra's rainbow/bow.
indrachapa.effects: Creativity, artistic talent, divine protection in its house

upaketu.name: Upaketu
upaketu.description: Mathematical upagraha derived from Sun. Similar to Ketu's effects.
upaketu.effects: Spiritual detachment, loss, liberation, past-life karmic effects

conjunction_with_planets.description: When an upagraha conjuncts a planet, it modifies the planet's results
conjunction_with_planets.benefic_conjunction: Reduces malefic effect of upagraha, planet protects the house
conjunction_with_planets.malefic_conjunction: Amplifies negative effects, both planet and house suffer
conjunction_with_planets.jupiter_conjunction: Significantly reduces malefic effects of any upagraha
conjunction_with_planets.venus_conjunction: Reduces negativity, especially in relationship matters

dusthana_placement.description: Malefic upagrahas in dusthana (6, 8, 12) can be less harmful
dusthana_placement.rule: A malefic in a malefic house can give positive results (vipareet effect)
dusthana_placement.example: Gulika in 6th: helps defeat enemies; in 8th: occult powers; in 12th: spiritual growth

aspect_rules.description: Upagrahas cast aspects like planets from their position
aspect_rules.benefic_aspects: Jupiter or Venus aspecting upagraha reduces its malefic effects
aspect_rules.malefic_aspects: Saturn or Mars aspecting upagraha intensifies negative effects

dhooma: Offer water to Sun at sunrise

sources.primary: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra - Chapter on Upagrahas
